hypothesis.statement: The remaining 66 words are TWO register exchanges plus their cascades, both now named with definition sites. SWAP A: the shared `row` web - target `addi r7,r3,-1` at +0x158 and `li r7,0` at +0x160, ours `addi r3,r3,-1` / `li r3,0` - against the if-branch-local `bp` web, target `addi r3,r24,1` at +0x174, ours `addi r7,r24,1`. The streams use the SAME colour set and merely exchange r3 and r7 between a common-block local and an if-branch local. SWAP B: the if-branch's narrow `nb` (target `li r4,0` at +0x1b0, ours `li r6,0`) against the common block's `y` (target `li r6,0` at +0x1b4, ours `li r4,0`). SWAP A is worth the whole else-branch cascade: there every web sits ONE register below the target's, each quoted at its definition site - y target `li r8,0` ours `li r7,0` at +0x28c, x target `li r11,0` ours `li r10,0` at +0x29c, dst target `add r9,r9,r0` ours `add r8,r0,r4` at +0x2ac, dst2 target `add r10,r9,r5` ours `add r9,r5,r8` at +0x2b0 - purely because our `row` freed r7 by taking r3. Every position and composition lever WITHIN each block is exhausted (see denial), so the untried lever moves a web ACROSS the block boundary without changing either block's population: give `bp` an initialiser at its declaration (`u8* bp = ip + 1;`), so that claim.law.SP_initializer-presence-outranks-declaration-position-in-callee-saved-numbering.20260901.v1's initialised-locals GROUP - EMPTY in this function today, every local being a plain C89 uninitialised declaration - acquires its first member and re-ranks bp against row.
